entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor lithomancer and planeswalker who fights Sorin at Markov Manor for her thousand-year imprisonment and the ruin of Zendikar, then leaves him trapped in stone.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: An ancient vampire planeswalker who leads a vampire army against Nahiri, is stabbed and trapped in a stone cocoon, and is left by Olivia.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A red-haired vampire in black plate armor who aids Sorin against Nahiri and then leaves him trapped, wanting to be Lord of Innistrad.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel Sorin created who is dead, whom Nahiri mocks.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who along with Sorin failed to answer Nahiri's call.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan visible on the horizon over Thraben, drifting across Gavony.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Sorin's plane, now overrun by Emrakul.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane, gutted by the Eldrazi in her absence.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Sorin's shattered ancestral manor reshaped by Nahiri, where the battle takes place.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city where Sorin created Avacyn and toward which Emrakul drifts.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A province across which Emrakul drifts.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison in which Nahiri was held for a thousand years.

entities.name: Cryptoliths
entities.description: Twisted stones that bend Innistrad's leylines, which Nahiri arranges to hide herself from the Eldrazi-touched monsters.

entities.name: Emrakul's Cultists
entities.description: Devotees of Emrakul who follow Nahiri and chant at Markov Manor.

entities.name: Voldaren Vampires
entities.description: The vampire knights and army assembled by Sorin and Olivia.

entities.name: Emrakul-Touched Monsters
entities.description: Scores of bulbous, contorted creatures mutated by Emrakul and held in Nahiri's vault.

events.summary: Nahiri, called the Harbinger by her cultists, waits at Markov Manor for Sorin.
events.quote: They called her the Harbinger.

events.summary: Sorin's vampire army arrives with banners and knights opposite the manor.
events.quote: The first of Sorin's forces to arrive were the banners, ancient cloths that hung from black wooden poles

events.summary: Nahiri steps out sword in hand to welcome Sorin.
events.quote: Sword in hand, Nahiri stepped out into the dull light of the day

events.summary: Nahiri kills a white-armored vampire and many others in the melee in the great hall.
events.quote: the vampire fell silent when a marble corbel smashed into her mouth, pulverizing those grotesque teeth.

events.summary: Nahiri raises stone walls to create a passage between her and Sorin and impales vampires and cultists on stone quills.
events.quote: on either side of her, two parallel walls rose up a dozen feet from the floor.

events.summary: Sorin launches death magic at Nahiri, but it veers away and strikes him, because magic flows through leylines and stone.
events.quote: They suddenly broke apart, and flew in several directions, tracing contours in the air that were otherwise invisible.

events.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she brought Emrakul to his doorstep.
events.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep, and you still think I'm a child.

events.summary: Nahiri declares she is done being a warden and that Zendikar will never again be a prison, so Emrakul had to go somewhere.
events.quote: I'm done being a warden, and Zendikar will never again be a prison.

events.summary: Olivia arrives overhead with vampire knights and says she cannot allow Nahiri her revenge.
events.quote: But he's also earned my help, so I can't allow you your revenge.

events.summary: Nahiri forges four more stone blades from white-hot stones.
events.quote: four blades, identical to the one she wielded, each one pulsing with energy of their stone forge.

events.summary: Nahiri rotates the hall and opens a wall, releasing scores of Emrakul-touched monsters.
events.quote: Scores of monsters, bulbous and contorted, with only vague hints at the people and animals they had once been.

events.summary: Nahiri's ring of ley stones renders her invisible to the monsters, which instead attack the vampires.
events.quote: These monsters were blind to her within her ring of ley stones.

events.summary: Olivia and her vampires wade into the monsters while Sorin pursues Nahiri through the floating ruins.
events.quote: By the time Nahiri was among the unmoored, broken remnants of the manor's vaulted ceiling, Sorin was on her heels.

events.summary: Nahiri upends a landing under Sorin, but he swings and escapes.
events.quote: Nahiri grabbed hold of the landing with her will and upended it.

events.summary: Sorin's blade breaches the stone and stabs Nahiri in the side.
events.quote: Then there was a loud crack, and agony shot through her side like a hot poker.

events.summary: Sorin stands over wounded Nahiri, saying she should have killed him when she had the chance.
events.quote: You had the chance to kill me, young one.

events.summary: Sorin bites Nahiri's neck and drinks her blood.
events.quote: Before a muscle could even twitch, she felt Sorin's teeth tear into her neck.

events.summary: Nahiri drives stone tusks into Sorin and traps him in a stone cocoon.
events.quote: The stone crashed in around them, and rows of jagged stone tusks tore into Sorin from his legs to his ribs.

events.summary: Nahiri whispers that she spared him, a courtesy returned.
events.quote: I spared you," Nahiri said. "A courtesy returned.

events.summary: Nahiri planeswalks away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin trapped.
events.quote: Nahiri planeswalked away from Innistrad, leaving Sorin to the fate of his world.

events.summary: Sorin, trapped, watches Emrakul drift across Gavony toward Thraben.
events.quote: The horizon was Emrakul.

events.summary: Olivia taunts Sorin, declares the bargain fulfilled, and leaves him trapped.
events.quote: Avacyn is dead. Nahiri has been driven off. Our bargain is fulfilled.

events.summary: Olivia pushes Sorin's sword against his cheek and floats away, leaving him in stone.
events.quote: you're where you are. I think it's quite good.

relations.note: She fights him for a thousand-year grudge.
Narration calls his words a mentor addressing a protege.
relations.quote: It was a mentor addressing a protégé, a final lesson to impart.

relations.note: He created Avacyn in Thraben to protect Innistrad.
relations.quote: Thraben was where he had created Avacyn to protect it.

relations.note: She aided him in a bargain, then left him trapped.
She brought the titan to Innistrad.
relations.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep
